Yes, London Drugs sells and distributes wearable medical devices and health tech through their [Connected Health & Wellness](https://www.londondrugs.com/category/connected-health-and-wellness/c/872) program and tech departments. They offer consumer smartwatches with health tracking as well as clinical-grade connected medical monitors. [](https://blog.londondrugs.com/how-connected-wellness-devices-can-help-you)

- **Continuous Glucose Monitors:** Abbott FreeStyle Libre and Dexcom (G6 and G7) systems.

- **Smartwatches and Fitness Wearables:** Apple Watch and Garmin and Fitbit models that track heart rate, blood oxygen, and activity.

- **Blood Pressure and Vitals Monitors:** Bluetooth-enabled Omron and Bios blood pressure cuffs and thermometers. [](https://blog.londondrugs.com/how-connected-wellness-devices-can-help-you)

### Services Provided

- **In-Store Setup:** Tech department staff help sync Bluetooth devices to mobile apps.

- **Pharmacy Support:** Pharmacists help interpret health readings and data sharing with caregivers. [](https://blog.londondrugs.com/how-connected-wellness-devices-can-help-you)
